display_long_description:
RNG God's is a VR experience unlike anything else — where skill means nothing and luck means everything. Make your way down the hall, press the button, and see what the RNG Gods have in store for you. No two runs are ever the same.
Every press of the button is a new surprise. Roll for cool cosmetics, powerful upgrades, and discover what fate has decided for you this time. The best part? It costs you nothing to roll — just pure RNG fun.
Push your luck further with 10 rebirths, unlock upgrades, and collect cosmetics as you go. The more you play, the more you discover — but remember, it's all in the hands of the RNG Gods.
Features:

10 rebirths to unlock
Upgrades and progression system
Cool cosmetics to collect
Pure RNG based gameplay
Endless replay ability
Immersive VR environment
Free to roll — no spending required

Are you ready to test your luck? The RNG Gods are waiting.
